sentinelValues.meaning: Is color -- the monitor is set to display in color.
Is gray scale -- the monitor is set to display in gray scale (Macintosh only).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the color depth (as an exponent of 2, i.e. number of colors = 2^depth) and color/gray-scale status of the monitor designated by screen.
overloadMerges.note: autoparse defaulted depth/color's direction to 'in'; the doc arrow column marks them as out-parameters filled by the command. Added sentinelValues for the color output's meaning.

constraints: If screen is omitted, the command returns information for the main screen.
The color value's gray-scale distinction (0) is only significant on the Macintosh platform.
